# EU regulation timeline

> Timeline, legislative procedures and official documents (as Markdown) of EU digital and product regulation: Cyber Resilience Act, NIS-2, Cybersecurity Act 2, AI Act, Digital Omnibus, New Legislative Framework and European Product Act, Machinery Regulation, GPSR, PLD, standardisation.

Unofficial Markdown conversion made for reading and searching; conversion errors are possible. Only the official document linked in `official_source` is authentic. Reuse: © European Union, EUR-Lex. Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6. © European Union, Council of the EU (Council register). Reuse: Council Decision (EU) 2017/1842, Article 6: source acknowledged, meaning not distorted, no liability of the Council. © European Union, European Parliament (EP Open Data Portal). Licence: CC BY 4.0. © European Union, European Commission (Register of Commission documents). Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6.

## Overview

- [Regulation timeline](https://git-z0man.github.io/eu-regulation-timeline/README.md): dates by act and profile
- [Legislative procedures](https://git-z0man.github.io/eu-regulation-timeline/procedures/README.md): stage, latest activity, next steps
- [Latest activity](https://git-z0man.github.io/eu-regulation-timeline/procedures/changes.md): new documents and events, newest first
- [Texts](https://git-z0man.github.io/eu-regulation-timeline/texts/README.md): index of all Markdown texts
